name: cellexia-subscription-app
description: Cellexia Continuous Treatment — subscription lifecycle optimisation app for Shopify

scripts.preview:local: DEMO_MODE=1 PORT=3901 SHOPIFY_API_KEY=dev-key SHOPIFY_API_SECRET=dev-secret SHOPIFY_APP_URL=http://localhost:3901 PORTAL_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3901 DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.sqlite MAGIC_LINK_SECRET=devsecret JOB_SECRET=devjob remix-serve ./build/server/index.js
scripts.setup:postgres: prisma generate --schema prisma/postgres/schema.prisma && prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/postgres/schema.prisma
scripts.docker-start: npm run setup:postgres && npm run start
